note: Gödel Agent：不依赖预定义流程与固定优化算法

note: DGM 的自指性：改自己的代码，从而改自己改代码的能力；用基准做经验验证

quote: an agent system, equipped with basic coding tools, can autonomously edit itself, and thereby improve its performance on benchmark tasks
note: SICA：不带梯度的自我修改

note: SICA 的量化结果

quote: continuously receiving feedback from one or more evaluators, AlphaEvolve iteratively improves the algorithm
note: AlphaEvolve：适应度来自一个或多个评估器，与 DGM 同型

note: ShinkaEvolve 指出代码演化路线的样本效率是瓶颈

note: DSPy：把管线编译成可优化对象，是把「外壳」参数化的最早形态之一

note: Absolute Zero：连问题都自产，外部数据量为零

note: SSR 的自改进量级

note: SEAL：奖励是「更新后模型在下游任务上的表现」，即自修改的效果本身

note: AgentEvolver 的三机制之一：自提问

note: On-Policy Self-Training：监督来自「特权推理示范」，即模型自己更会做的版本

note: SiriuS：经验库只保留通向成功的轨迹——第三波里仍以「结果」为筛选依据的形态

note: HS-STaR：难度即价值，边界问题效用最高（课程自举的经验依据）

note: GMAE：奖励本身依赖随机分组的上下文——自举信号的方差来源被显式建模

quote: RLSVR transforms open-ended tasks into verifiable proxy environments whose internal rules and interaction outcomes automatically generate reward signals
note: RLSVR：把开放任务改造成「可自验证」的代理环境，是锚点外移的一种（造出新验证器）

quote: the model tends to over-reward high-confidence mistakes, forming a self-confirming loop
note: 自评路线的核心失效：高置信度错误被系统性高估，形成自我确认循环

note: 多轮 agent RL 的 Echo Trap：奖励方差悬崖与梯度尖峰

note: 最强的反证：RLVR 并未引出新的推理模式

quote: the base models achieve a higher pass@k score when k is large
note: 同一篇的量化依据：大 k 时基座模型反而更高——能力边界没扩张

quote: use of model-generated content in training causes irreversible defects in the resulting models, where tails of the original content distribution disappear
note: 模型坍缩的原命题：分布尾部的不可逆损失

quote: accumulating the successive generations of synthetic data alongside the original real data avoids model collapse
note: 坍缩可避免的条件：累积而非替换真实数据——这是「保留外部性」的具体形式

quote: even data accumulation does not appear to arrest this drift
note: 反例：采样温度小于 1 时，累积也止不住谱隙收窄

note: 理论侧：对初始模型的依赖随迭代指数衰减——形式化地说明「外部性被兑换掉」

quote: performance improves at a rate of $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}\left(1/\sqrt{n}\right)$ with sample size $n$
note: 同一篇的收敛速率

quote: When safeguards overlap, deleting one is masked: the others still block the harm, so the gate decides on task success alone and redundancy erodes unseen
note: Masked Erosion：验收门的冗余防护被无声侵蚀——harness 路线的特有失效

quote: Verifier strength $σ$ is how well the available verifier -- often an LLM judge -- agrees with a trusted reference verifier
note: 可测量前置条件之一：验证器强度 sigma

quote: Recoverability is how cheaply a bad change can be undone
note: 可测量前置条件之二：可恢复性

note: 同一篇：60% 在未被选择用过的任务上评测——比 22% 好看，但差距本身是缺口

quote: self-modification alone does not guarantee trustworthy improvement
note: 可信 RSI 综述的核心命题

quote: This literature uses a vocabulary ("self-refine," "self-reward," "self-play," "self-evolve") that conflates fundamentally different ambitions.
note: RSI 综述：同一套词汇混着根本不同的野心

quote: We survey 1,250 arXiv papers (2024-2026) along two axes
note: 同一篇的取材规模，用于对照本文的 61 篇

quote: Techniques that enhance inference through increased computation at test-time have recently gained attention
note: 推理时自改进这一支的定位

quote: remain fundamentally static, unable to adapt their internal parameters to novel tasks
note: 自演化 agent 综述给出的出发点：模型本身是静态的

note: Reflexion 明确不走权重路线——外壳路线的最早形态

note: Voyager 的技能库：把经验固化成可执行代码，而非权重

note: AWM：把复用的工作流抽成记忆，是「上下文层自举」的量化证据

quote: A meta-agent rewrites this policy using evidence from earlier runs
note: RSI-Opt：让 agent 改进「指导训练优化器的策略」——改进过程本身被自举

note: Recursa：知识仓库的递归精炼，在留出任务上的量化结果
